1.title: A Sympathetic Defendant and Well-Crafted Defense Dominated Clancy Trial
1.summary: The defense lawyer for Lindsay Clancy showed empathy for his client in showcasing her mental health problems. That may have made all the difference.

2.title: Trump Officials Draft Plan to Pay At-Home Parents, Using Funds for Working Ones
2.summary: The proposed benefit, a top policy priority for Vice President JD Vance, would apply only to married couples and tap a fund intended to provide federal child care subsidies to working parents.

3.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
3.summary: The US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers, while Iran says it targeted three US-linked ships.

4.title: After Months at War, Brief Solace in a Party Town Far From Home
4.summary: A stopover in Thailand was welcome relief for thousands of troops aboard the U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln from a grueling deployment. But it was not a complete salve.

5.title: U.S. Strikes Three Iranian ‘Shadow Network’ Oil Tankers, Military Says
5.summary: The U.S. military said it retaliated after Iran launched missiles at two warships. The strikes came days after the two sides exchanged some of their most intense fire in weeks.
